topic: Mixing, bandwidth, deviation and intermodulation (G8B; 13 pool questions)

questions.question: Which mixer input is varied or tuned to convert signals of different frequencies to an intermediate frequency (IF)?
What is the term for interference from a signal at twice the IF frequency from the desired signal?
What is another term for the mixing of two RF signals?
What is the stage in a VHF FM transmitter that generates a harmonic of a lower frequency signal to reach the desired operating frequency?
Which intermodulation products are closest to the original signal frequencies?
What is the total bandwidth of an FM phone transmission having 5 kHz deviation and 3 kHz modulating frequency?
What is the frequency deviation for a 12.21 MHz reactance modulated oscillator in a 5 kHz deviation, 146.52 MHz FM phone transmitter?
Why is it important to know the duty cycle of the mode you are using when transmitting?

choices.A: To aid in tuning your transmitter
choices.B: Some modes have high duty cycles that could exceed the transmitter’s average power rating
choices.C: To allow time for the other station to break in during a transmission

questions.answer: Some modes have high duty cycles that could exceed the transmitter’s average power rating

questions.question: Why is it good to match receiver bandwidth to the bandwidth of the operating mode?

choices.A: It is required by FCC rules
choices.B: It minimizes power consumption in the receiver
choices.C: It improves impedance matching of the antenna
choices.D: It results in the best signal-to-noise ratio

questions.answer: It results in the best signal-to-noise ratio

questions.question: What is the relationship between transmitted symbol rate and bandwidth?

choices.A: Symbol rate and bandwidth are not related
choices.B: Higher symbol rates require wider bandwidth
choices.C: Lower symbol rates require wider bandwidth
choices.D: Bandwidth is half the symbol rate

questions.answer: Higher symbol rates require wider bandwidth
